rawContent: #MeToo   Happened when I was  10, but guess what,  I'm over it.   I didn't let it rule my life.  I don't need a Survivor's March to validate myself.

I'm pretty much fed up with all of these decades old sexual assault reports.  If you didn't report it then, don't report it now.  memories don't get better with age, facts get distorted and inflated.  hard to prove or disprove #MeToo
